name: CUTEst
description: CUTEst (Constrained and Unconstrained Testing Environment with safe threads) is a large test-set and software environment for nonlinear and continuous optimization solvers. It provides on the order of 1500 problems encoded in the Standard Input Format (SIF), spanning unconstrained, bound-constrained, and generally constrained nonlinear programs, together with interfaces that expose objective, gradient, Hessian, and constraint evaluations to solvers. It is the successor to the earlier CUTE and CUTEr environments and is the standard testbed for derivative-based nonlinear optimization methods.
evaluation_method: convergence / iterations / function evaluations to optimality
general_score_metric: iterations / function evaluations to convergence (often via performance profiles)
typical_sota_score: Solver-dependent; results are reported as Dolan-More performance profiles over the test set rather than a single score.
reputation: The standard test environment for nonlinear continuous optimization solvers; widely used to benchmark line-search, trust-region, interior-point, and SQP methods.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; targets numerical optimization solvers and requires a SIF decoder plus solver interfaces. Many problems are scalable in dimension. Distinct from black-box suites such as COCO/BBOB because gradients and Hessians are available.
